limitations: Four curated positive labels cannot estimate whole-project precision or recall; unlabelled edges are explicitly excluded. Precision is deliberately null rather than a tautological 1.0 computed after selecting only known positives.
All queries captured their reported section totals, but global C/Cython/other parse failures remain and runtime/build coverage is not established.
No NumPy code was imported or executed; this run does not verify numerical behavior, public dispatch, native implementations, or feature flags.
Named unresolved endpoints remain candidate evidence and cannot establish an exact function identity.
Docstring name extraction is a heuristic probe. Natural-language tokens in that list are not treated as exact endpoint labels or true negatives.
The empty Python-call sample has a known native caller and must not be described as having no runtime relationships.
The passing strict suite exposed no raw docstring defect with this binary, but additional evidence exposed AMU import-resolution defects and prompted new regressions.
Post-fix candidate retention and verified-identity scores are separate; a retained uncertain edge does not become a verified true positive.
